A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the actors in the REDD+ working group in Peru are aware of synergies and risks between REDD+ implementation and biodiversity conservation.

actors in REDD + processes in Peru perceive REDD + implementation as a potential opportunity to conserve biodiversity, and that the integration of biodiversity conservation values into REDD + is generally recognised, but the long-term integrity aspects of forests are not yet considered sufficiently.

the actors in the REDD+ process in Peru are aware that REDD+ can be an opportunity to promote biodiversity conservation and are open for integrating biodiversity conservation into REDD+ implementation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the actors in REDD+-related working groups in Peru are aware that biodiversity is important, but that they focus mainly on aspects that have direct use values.

REDD+ implementation can contribute to the conservation of many biodiversity aspects with direct and indirect use values, but that it will not necessarily contribute to the conservation or restoration of biodiversity values that have option and resilience values, unless safeguards are integrated in REDD+ policies.

actors in REDD + implementation processes in Peru generally recognise the importance of biodiversity conservation, but the integration of biodiversity values into REDD+ strategies and policies remains a challenge.
